recentItems.title: Rescuers race to search for missing after Nepal-Tibet flash floods kill at least 160 | ANC
recentItems.description:
Rescue teams rushed Thursday (August 27) to find more than 1,000 people missing on the Nepal-Tibet border in flash floods and landslides that killed at least 165 and swept away entire villages.

A terrifying clip of surveillance video from the Chinese side of the frontier shows a massive wall of mud and debris crashing over a building several stories high on Wednesday morning, engulfing it as dozens of people ran for their lives below. The surge swept away buses and cars like they were toys. — Report from Agence France-Presse

recentItems.title: LIVE: Malacañang holds press briefing with PCO Usec. Claire Castro | August 27, 2026
recentItems.description:
Palace Press Officer Undersecretary Claire Castro led a press briefing addressing several pressing national issues and executive updates. A key highlight was Malacañang's firm response to Senator Robin Padilla's controversial comparison of historical heroes' pseudonyms to the alias names found on the Office of the Vice President's (OVP) confidential fund receipts.

The briefing also highlighted President Ferdinand R. Marcos Jr.'s conferment of a Doctor of Laws Honoris Causa degree by Pamantasan ng Lungsod ng Maynila (PLM) and his official visit supporting egg producers in Batangas. Additional updates covered the Military and Uniformed Personnel (MUP) pension system review, ongoing discussions regarding Facebook content moderation, and funding enhancements for AI-driven flood forecasting via Project NOA.

recentItems.title: DPWH seeks P83.84B for locally funded flood control projects | ANC
recentItems.description:
The Department of Public Works and Highways seeks P83.84 billion for locally funded flood control projects next year, with its chief, Secretary Vince Dizon saying Wednesday (August 26) that the proposed 2027 budget contains no “leadership funds”.

Former DPWH Secretary Manuel Bonoan previously said “leadership funds” were meant to accommodate priority projects of senators in the 2025 budget. But senators have denied the discretionary allocations, while stressing that budget amendments are part of the process. — Report from Vivienne Gulla, ABS-CBN News

recentItems.title: Police file charges vs AdZU shooter's father, security guard | ANC
recentItems.description:
Charges have been filed against the father of the student involved in the August 18 shooting in Zamboanga City and a school security personnel following the completion of the Philippine National Police (PNP) investigation. 

The two face a complaint for reckless imprudence resulting in homicide and physical injury based on evidence gathered by the Police Regional Office 9-led Special Investigation Task Group. — Report from Queenie Casimiro, Karen De Guzman, ABS-CBN News
